answer_2.quote: We use 225 as the maximum sequence length throughout our experiments and report Word Error Rate (WER) and Character Error Rate (CER) as our evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: Each annotator of the data was made fully aware of the research objectives of the study and the intended use of their annotations.
answer_4.guideline: We task native speakers of each dialect to annotate segments from local TV series sourced from YouTube.
